mapper.select: SELECT a.id AS appointment_id, a.doctor_id, a.patient_id, pt.user_id AS patient_user_id, a.status, p.status AS payment_status FROM appointment a INNER JOIN doctor d ON d.id = a.doctor_id INNER JOIN patient pt ON pt.id = a.patient_id LEFT JOIN payment p ON p.appointment_id = a.id WHERE a.id = #{appointmentId} AND d.user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id AS queue_id, status FROM queue WHERE appointment_id = #{appointmentId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE appointment SET status = '接诊中' WHERE id = #{appointmentId} AND status = '已签到'
UPDATE queue SET status = '接诊中' WHERE id = #{queueId} AND status = '等待接诊'
UPDATE appointment SET status = '已完成' WHERE id = #{appointmentId} AND status = '接诊中'
UPDATE queue SET status = '已完成' WHERE id = #{queueId} AND status = '接诊中'
